kind: static and pure model checks; no browser execution

checks.name: Complete graph node and edge references

Legacy classification respects negation and mixed source
Old and current loss functions remain separately searchable

All declarations have nonzero ranges and no fake binary LOC
Capability evidence survives UI payload deduplication

Filters and complete search respect user criteria
All UI JavaScript parses without external imports
HTML resources are local and relative, including domain source links
